panel-002.alt: HOGIRL marking places on a phone map.

captions.text:
Back then,
there was so much I wanted to see.

panel-003.alt: HOGIRL and friends studying a recipe in a kitchen.

captions.text:
There was no end to what I wanted
to taste, to learn, and to understand.

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL asking questions in a shop.

captions.text:
When something was good,
I wanted to know why.
What’s your signature?
What’s the most popular?

“Delicious” and “beautiful”
weren’t enough.

I wanted to know
how it was made.

panel-006.alt: HOGIRL and friends researching places in Paris.

captions.text:
One thing always
led to another.

panel-008.alt: A pear-shaped dessert and friends tasting desserts.

captions.text:
Every discovery felt like
I had learned something new.

panel-009.alt: A Paris street with the Eiffel Tower.

captions.text:
When class ended,
all of Paris became my classroom.

panel-010.alt: HOGIRL and friends walking beside the Seine.

captions.text:
The old.
The new.

panel-011.alt: People looking through goods at an outdoor flea market.

captions.text:
Everything I saw became something else
in my head.

panel-012.alt: HOGIRL holding up a plate at a flea market.

panel-013.alt: HOGIRL photographing a display in a chocolate shop.

panel-014.alt: HOGIRL looking toward a class in a modern pastry lab.

captions.text:
I was soaking it all in
like a sponge.

panel-015.alt: HOGIRL and friends at a worktable with pastry tools.

captions.text:
The more I learned,
the more I wanted to know.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL observing a chef and chocolate work.

captions.text: The days felt too short.

Even after using every bit of one,
I couldn’t wait for the next.

panel-017.alt: HOGIRL and friends watching an outdoor fashion show.

captions.text: Curiosity was bigger than worry.

Excitement came faster
than hesitation.

panel-018.alt: HOGIRL outside a Paris hotel entrance.

captions.text:
I knew what I wanted to do.
And I was doing it.

Back then,
that was enough to make me happy.

panel-019.alt: HOGIRL and friends on a Paris shopping street.

captions.text:
Back then,
I thought life would keep going like this.

Of course,
life can’t always stay that way.

panel-020.alt: HOGIRL outside a Paris hotel entrance.

captions.text:
Still, whenever I think
of those days,
I was shining so brightly then.
I’m proud of the girl I was.

The girl who gave herself so fully
to life, and to her dreams.
